name: vscode-raycast-bridge
description: Use Raycast AI as a chat model in VS Code, and run Raycast commands and AI quick actions on your selection.

raycastBridge.owner.description: Your Raycast Store handle. Used as the <author-or-owner> segment of raycast:// deeplinks.

raycastBridge.models.description: Raycast AI model ids to offer in the chat model picker. Edit with 'Raycast: Select Chat Models'. Raycast's own default is always offered.

default.label: Translate to Chinese
default.prompt: Translate the following text into Chinese. Output only the translation.

default.label: Explain
default.prompt: Explain the following in plain language. Be brief.

default.label: Polish as Academic English
default.prompt: Rewrite the following as clear academic English. Output only the rewritten text.

raycastBridge.quickActions.description: Actions offered on the editor selection. The answer appears in a hover next to the selection. To give one a keyboard shortcut, bind raycastBridge.quickAction with the action's label as an argument in keybindings.json: { "key": "cmd+k t", "command": "raycastBridge.quickAction", "args": { "action": "Translate to Chinese" }, "when": "editorHasSelection" }. The Keyboard Shortcuts editor cannot set arguments, so this binding has to be written by hand.

label.description: Menu entry text, and the name a keyboard shortcut binds to. Matched ignoring case.

prompt.description: Instruction sent to Raycast AI. The selected text is appended to it. Write {{selection}} to place the text somewhere other than the end, or more than once.

model.description: Raycast model id for this action. Omit to use Raycast's default model. Set it with 'Raycast: Select Quick Action Model' rather than by hand.

enumDescriptions: Show both the lightbulb entry and the code lens.
Lightbulb entry only; costs a second click but never shifts the layout.
Code lens only; one click, but adds a line above the selection.
raycastBridge.quickActionsUI.description: Where quick actions appear when text is selected.

enumDescriptions: A block under the selection. Stays until dismissed, and streams the answer in as it arrives.
A hover next to the selection. Costs no layout, but a scroll or a click elsewhere dismisses it and the answer only appears once it is complete.
raycastBridge.quickActionsDisplay.description: How a quick action's answer is shown.

raycastBridge.commands.description: Raycast commands to offer in 'Raycast: Run Command'. Get a deeplink via the Copy Deeplink action in Raycast root search.

passSelectionAs.description: How to inject the editor selection: 'fallbackText', 'argument:<name>', or 'context:<key>'.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
